observed_result: On-target ALT support fell to 0/14 evaluable parent reads under targeted PM2.
The controlled targeted condition produced downstream loss of the F11 variant call.
Clean ALT support was retained in 14/14 evaluable parents.
Off-target PM2 sham preserved ALT evidence in 14/14 evaluable parents and preserved the heterozygous call.
Modelled re-identification reached 100 percent by year 13 and familial exposure reached 100 percent by year 15.
The authoritative graph contained 4144 nodes with 1657 registered nodes; calibrated mean familial amplification was 464.4x.
Primary containment achieved 99.24 percent best reduction; minimum tested k for >=99 percent reduction was 5 for peripheral origins and 20 for mid-degree and hub origins.
Final benchmark threshold 3.6 produced precision 0.9070, recall 0.7800, F1 0.8387 and accuracy 0.9400.
